The writer's answers let me add real specifics (312 videos, the 4.6 rating, Gwen Harper's story, what Premium adds). They also confirmed several lines I should keep general, so I left reminders, progress sharing and history without invented details. I dropped "unlock more of what the app has to offer" because the answers gave a concrete replacement, and I cut the "trust" and "real recovery" slogans.

<final>
Stepwise: Home Exercise for PT

Clear exercises from licensed physical therapists, so you know what to do at home and how to do it right.

I built Stepwise because I think patients skip their exercises more often than they lack instructions. That's why the app has reminders and a way to share your progress with your PT.

WHY STEPWISE

• 312 video exercises. Each one is filmed by a licensed physical therapist, so you can see proper form for every movement.

• Reminders. Set a schedule that fits your day and get a nudge when it's time to exercise.

• Progress sharing. Let your physical therapist see how you're doing between visits, so they can adjust your plan.

WHO IT'S FOR

Gwen Harper used Stepwise after a knee replacement and was back to hiking in four months. Whether you're healing from surgery, managing an injury, or working on strength and mobility, you can follow along with each video, check off your exercises, and see how far you've come. The app has a 4.6 rating from about 1,900 reviews.

FREE TO START

Download Stepwise and get started at no cost. Stepwise Premium is $7.99 per month and adds custom programs that your PT can build for you.

Subscription details: Premium is billed monthly at $7.99 and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

Stepwise is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Talk with your physical therapist or healthcare provider before starting any exercise program.
</final>
